completion:
Identify the correct failure reason for each failed specification:
   - Timeout: value not available in time
   - Mismatch: failed value differs from expected value
   - Wrong format: value not in specified format but can be converted to
   - Null/NA: expected value is missing
   - Exception raised: couldn’t execute the operation
3. Determine the correct failure type for each failed specification:
   - Critical: system cannot work/condition where all downstream data is unusable
   - Non-critical: system can work for other uses
